Computing Simple Interest
30

Problem Statement
Read the principal, rate, and time, then compute the simple interest using the standard formula.
Description
Read three float values: principal (P), rate (R), and time (T). Compute the simple interest using SI = (P * R * T) / 100 and print the result rounded to two decimal places.
Input Description
Three values P, R, and T, separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the simple interest, rounded to two decimal places.
Sample Input
1000 5 2
Sample Output
100.00
